house:119:2:218.question: On Passage
house:119:2:218.reason: Complete H.R.8312 EH and own full floor reproduction are read and match under declared formatting comparison, with the substitute adopted under H.Res.1345 section1. Fiscal Service fraud/payment-integrity functions are noninvestigative/nonlaw-enforcement, qualified financial-loss analytics rather than policy enforcement; permanent IG powers are separate. DNP applicable-law and Privacy Act limits, voluntary State/local/tribal services and bulk/realtime sharing agreements remain qualified. DATA Act inserted FFATA6(c)(1) may-to-shall change is separate. New section 317 IG oversight covers the 13 listed categories in 317(l)(2)(A), including SBA loans under multiple laws, unemployment compensation and whole PL11921, plus (B) Federal awards of at least $50,000, (C) intramural research payments and (D) emergency disaster-relief or economic-recovery spending; current PRAC also gained thisAct coverage through enacted90102, which changed original2025 termination to2034. Original completeCARES15010 and literal90102 are read; intervening covered-fund Acts/current integration remain research. The bill section5 targets CARES15010(k) but parenthetical15US9053 identifiesSIGPR/CARES4018, and section3(b) literally cites317(n) while definitions are317(l); Recovery/Prevention transition title mismatch and undefined center remain literal, not repaired. IG406(f3) treatment waives initialAGdetermination only; guidelines/rescission/review safeguards remain. Rendered403/406 baselines retain material Amendments Not Shown qualifications; transition notwithstanding403 andVacanciesAct is not asserted as unrestricted permanent appointment. Qualified staffing and annuitant paragraphs, audit standards, disclosure/privacy exclusions, agency responses, independence/funding bounds retained. December31,2028 effective date differs FY2035 annual10m authorization; assets/unobligated funds transfer with original-purpose exception, not unlimited current spending. Keep unresolved/noncounting pending exact cross-reference/integration and bounded Immigration application of covered funds. No automatic inclusion/exclusion from titles/agencies or wholeAct context, individual criminal/benefit-status ruling, existing core reinterpretation or hold release. Initial question precedes voice ayes, Walkinshaw demand/order and postponement; recorded240-181 with10NotVoting, Foushee Nay/Massie Yea; Rouzer hypothetical stated intention excluded.
